name: Yet another customizable box / project enclosure.

captions.detailed: This 3D model consists of a two-piece rectangular project box with rounded corners, featuring a main container and a matching lid. The main box has a recessed lip at the top rim to allow the lid to fit securely over it. The separate lid is flat with a shallow raised rim around its perimeter to mate with the box's recessed lip. All vertical corners are smooth and rounded, giving the assembly a clean, modern look suitable for electronic enclosures.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric rectangular project box with a separate mating lid in OpenSCAD. The user should be able to adjust the overall width, length, height, wall thickness, corner radius, and lid thickness, with options to toggle the rendering of the box and lid individually.
captions.factory: The code generates two main parts: the box and the lid. It uses the minkowski() operator on a centered cube and a cylinder to create rounded-corner solids, adjusting the dimensions to account for the corner radius. The main box is built by unioning a base body and a smaller lip body, then subtracting an inner hollow volume using difference(). The lid is generated similarly by hollowing out a rounded-corner flat plate to create a lip that fits over the box rim, utilizing translate() to position both parts side-by-side.
